title: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder And Inorder Traversal
statement:
Given the preorder and inorder traversals of the same binary tree, construct and return the tree. All node values are unique.

## Examples

```text
Input: preorder = [3, 9, 20, 15, 7], inorder = [9, 3, 15, 20, 7]
Output: [3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7]
```

```text
Input: preorder = [-1], inorder = [-1]
Output: [-1]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= preorder.length == inorder.length <= 3000`
- `-3000 <= preorder[i], inorder[i] <= 3000`
- Values in each traversal are unique, and both arrays describe a valid tree.
